title: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before
question: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    platform,
    age_band,
    demographic,
    customer_type,
    sales,
    CASE
      WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN 'before'
      ELSE 'after'
    END AS period
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= '2020-03-16'
    AND week_date < '2020-09-08'
    AND week_date != '2020-06-15'
),
region_b AS (SELECT region, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'before' GROUP BY region),
region_a AS (SELECT region, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'after' GROUP BY region),
platform_b AS (SELECT platform, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'before' GROUP BY platform),
platform_a AS (SELECT platform, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'after' GROUP BY platform),
age_b AS (SELECT age_band, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'before' GROUP BY age_band),
age_a AS (SELECT age_band, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'after' GROUP BY age_band),
demo_b AS (SELECT demographic, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'before' GROUP BY demographic),
demo_a AS (SELECT demographic, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'after' GROUP BY demographic),
cust_b AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'before' GROUP BY customer_type),
cust_a AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'after' GROUP BY customer_type),
by_attr AS (
  SELECT 'region' AS attr_type, (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s AS pct
  FROM region_b b JOIN region_a a ON b.region = a.region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform', (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s
  FROM platform_b b JOIN platform_a a ON b.platform = a.platform
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band', (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s
  FROM age_b b JOIN age_a a ON b.age_band = a.age_band
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic', (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s
  FROM demo_b b JOIN demo_a a ON b.demographic = a.demographic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type', (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s
  FROM cust_b b JOIN cust_a a ON b.customer_type = a.customer_type
),
attr_avg AS (
  SELECT attr_type, AVG(pct) AS avg_pct
  FROM by_attr
  GROUP BY attr_type
)
SELECT attr_type, ROUND(avg_pct, 4) AS avg_pct_change
FROM attr_avg
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
         CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period,
         sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= '2020-03-23' AND week_date <= '2020-09-07'
),
piv AS (
  SELECT region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
         SUM(CASE WHEN period='before' THEN sales END) AS s_before,
         SUM(CASE WHEN period='after' THEN sales END) AS s_after
  FROM base GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
attr AS (
  SELECT 'region' AS attr_type, region AS attr_value,
         AVG((s_after - s_before)*100.0/s_before) AS avg_pct
  FROM piv WHERE s_before IS NOT NULL AND s_before<>0 AND s_after IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform', platform, AVG((s_after - s_before)*100.0/s_before)
  FROM piv WHERE s_before IS NOT NULL AND s_before<>0 AND s_after IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY platform
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band', age_band, AVG((s_after - s_before)*100.0/s_before)
  FROM piv WHERE s_before IS NOT NULL AND s_before<>0 AND s_after IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY age_band
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic', demographic, AVG((s_after - s_before)*100.0/s_before)
  FROM piv WHERE s_before IS NOT NULL AND s_before<>0 AND s_after IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY demographic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type', customer_type, AVG((s_after - s_before)*100.0/s_before)
  FROM piv WHERE s_before IS NOT NULL AND s_before<>0 AND s_after IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_type
)
SELECT attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct),4) AS avg_pct_change
FROM attr
GROUP BY attr_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change

demo_b AS (SELECT demographic, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'before' GROUP BY demographic),
demo_a AS (SELECT demographic, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'after' GROUP BY demographic),
cust_b AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'before' GROUP BY customer_type),
cust_a AS (SELECT customer_type, SUM(sales) AS s FROM base WHERE period = 'after' GROUP BY customer_type),
by_attr AS (
  SELECT 'region' AS attr_type, (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s AS pct
  FROM region_b b JOIN region_a a ON b.region = a.region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform', (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s
  FROM platform_b b JOIN platform_a a ON b.platform = a.platform
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band', (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s
  FROM age_b b JOIN age_a a ON b.age_band = a.age_band
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic', (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s
  FROM demo_b b JOIN demo_a a ON b.demographic = a.demographic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type', (a.s - b.s) * 100.0 / b.s
  FROM cust_b b JOIN cust_a a ON b.customer_type = a.customer_type
),
attr_avg AS (
  SELECT attr_type, AVG(pct) AS avg_pct
  FROM by_attr
  GROUP BY attr_type
)
SELECT attr_type, ROUND(avg_pct, 4) AS avg_pct_change
FROM attr_avg
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
